summary.en: At 08:54 ET, Nasdaq-100 futures fell 2.05%, S&P 500 futures 1.23% and Dow futures 0.60% from their respective Monday 16:00 ET readings. Monday's cash session had ended with the S&P 500 up 4.60% and the Nasdaq Composite up 6.36%. The 10-year yield and dollar were lower this morning. The Philadelphia Fed's regional nonmanufacturing index improved but stayed negative, and Analog Devices reported record fiscal fourth-quarter revenue. Tuesday's consumer confidence data and Wednesday's PCE inflation report are the next major tests.
summary.zh: 美东时间08:54，纳指100、标普500及道指期货较各自周一16:00的参考值分别下跌2.05%、1.23%和0.60%。周一现货收盘时，标普500上涨4.60%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨6.36%。今早10年期美债收益率和美元走低。费城联储非制造业调查的地区活动指数回升但仍为负值，亚德诺公布创纪录的财年第四季度营收。接下来关注周二消费者信心和周三PCE通胀数据。

title.en: Nasdaq-100 futures lead declines after Monday's Nvidia rally
title.zh: 英伟达带动周一大涨后，纳指100期货盘前领跌

impact.en: Reuters reported that Nvidia rose 31.5% in Monday's cash session after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, adding nearly $1 trillion in market value. The same report put Nvidia down 5.2% early Tuesday, with Micron, AMD and Marvell down between 3.9% and 6.4%. The separate 08:54 ET market snapshot put Nasdaq-100 futures down 2.05% against Monday's 16:00 ET reading for the same contract.
impact.zh: 据路透社报道，黄仁勋重任首席执行官后，英伟达在周一现货交易中上涨31.5%，市值增加近1万亿美元。同一篇报道显示，周二早盘英伟达下跌5.2%，美光、AMD和Marvell下跌3.9%至6.4%。另一组美东时间08:54的行情显示，纳指100期货较该合约周一16:00的参考值下跌2.05%。

bullish: Monday's cash gains show the scale of the rebound before this morning's weakness. / 周一现货涨幅显示了今早回落之前的反弹力度。
bearish: Losses across several chipmakers in Reuters' early snapshot show the pullback extended beyond Nvidia. / 路透社记录的早盘行情显示多家芯片股走低，跌势已超出英伟达一家。

macroRisk.en: Reuters' early account, citing CME FedWatch, pointed to a 25-basis-point December hike already priced and a small chance of a larger move. Wednesday's October PCE report is a key test of that pricing ahead of the December decision.
macroRisk.zh: 路透社早盘援引CME FedWatch称，市场已计入12月加息25个基点，并认为更大幅度加息的概率较低。周三公布的10月PCE数据是12月议息决定前检验这一市场预期的重要参考。

title.en: Dollar weakens broadly early Tuesday while yen lags
title.zh: 周二早盘美元普遍走弱，日元表现落后

impact.en: MT Newswires reported early Tuesday that EUR/USD rose to 1.0951 from 1.0902 and USD/JPY rose to 159.1521 from 158.9442, each against Monday's U.S. closing reference cited in the same report. Separately, the 08:55 ET dollar index was 103.89, down 0.44% from its Monday 16:00 ET reading.
impact.zh: MT Newswires报道称，周二早盘欧元兑美元从1.0902升至1.0951，美元兑日元从158.9442升至159.1521，均与同一报道所列周一美国市场收盘参考值相比。另一组行情显示，美东时间08:55美元指数为103.89，较周一16:00的参考值下跌0.44%。

bullish: A softer dollar and lower Treasury yields could ease some of the pressure on rate-sensitive shares. / 美元和美债收益率走低，可能缓解对利率敏感股票的部分压力。
bearish: The dollar's gain versus the yen shows that the early weakening was uneven across currency pairs. / 美元兑日元反而走强，表明早盘美元走弱并未覆盖所有货币对。

macroRisk.en: Consumer confidence and Richmond Fed regional readings are scheduled for 10:00 ET, after the cash open. Their release may change the dollar and rates picture later in the session.
macroRisk.zh: 消费者信心和里士满联储地区数据定于现货开盘后的美东时间10:00公布，届时美元和利率走势可能变化。

title.en: Philadelphia Fed regional activity index rises to -1.5 in November
title.zh: 费城联储11月非制造业地区活动指数回升至负1.5点

impact.en: The Philadelphia Fed's 08:30 ET November survey showed the regional nonmanufacturing activity index improving to -1.5 from -23.6 in October. Activity at respondents' own firms rose to +14.3 from +12.9, while new orders slipped to -0.6 from +2.8. The share reporting weaker regional activity still exceeded the share reporting improvement, by a much smaller margin than in October.
impact.zh: 费城联储在美东时间08:30公布的11月调查显示，非制造业地区活动指数从10月的负23.6点升至负1.5点。受访企业自身活动指数由正12.9点升至正14.3点，新订单指数则由正2.8点降至负0.6点。报告地区活动走弱的企业占比仍高于报告改善的占比，但两者的差距较10月明显缩小。

bullish: The regional index moved closer to zero and the firm-level reading improved. / 地区活动指数接近零，企业自身活动指数进一步上升。
bearish: The new-orders index moved below zero, while the prices-paid index rose to +45.8 from +42.1. / 新订单指数跌至零以下，投入价格指数由正42.1点升至正45.8点。

macroRisk.en: This is a regional diffusion survey. The national consumer confidence release and Wednesday's GDP and inflation data offer broader context.
macroRisk.zh: 这是一项地区性扩散指数调查。全国消费者信心以及周三的GDP和通胀数据将提供更广泛的参考。

title.en: Analog Devices posts record $4.37 billion fiscal fourth-quarter revenue
title.zh: 亚德诺财年第四季度营收创43.7亿美元纪录

impact.en: Analog Devices reported at 07:01 ET that fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 42% from a year earlier to $4.37 billion, led by data center and industrial demand. Adjusted diluted earnings per share rose 80% to $4.06. The company forecast fiscal first-quarter revenue of $4.4 billion, plus or minus $150 million, and adjusted EPS of $3.82, plus or minus $0.20.
impact.zh: 亚德诺于美东时间07:01发布财报，财年第四季度营收同比增长42%至43.7亿美元，数据中心和工业业务领涨。调整后摊薄每股收益同比增长80%至4.06美元。公司预计下一财年第一季度营收44亿美元，上下浮动1.5亿美元，调整后每股收益3.82美元，上下浮动0.20美元。

bullish: Data center and industrial demand led growth across the quarter. / 数据中心和工业业务是本季度增长的主要来源。
bearish: At the midpoint, next quarter's adjusted EPS guidance is below the reported quarter's $4.06. / 下一季度调整后每股收益指引中值低于本季度已公布的4.06美元。

macroRisk.en: The company is scheduled to discuss the guidance at 10:00 ET, after the cash open. The call may clarify how industrial and AI infrastructure demand contribute to its outlook.
macroRisk.zh: 公司定于现货开盘后的美东时间10:00召开财报电话会，届时可进一步了解工业和人工智能基础设施需求对公司展望的影响。

keyRisk.en: At the 09:30 ET cash open, watch whether weakness extends beyond semiconductor and other large technology shares, and whether the 10-year yield stays below its Monday reference. The 10:00 ET consumer confidence release and Analog Devices call are later tests. Wednesday's October PCE inflation and second estimate of third-quarter GDP are scheduled for 08:30 ET.

note.en: The opening bias is defensive, especially in technology. Nasdaq-100 futures fell 2.05% and S&P 500 futures fell 1.23% against their own Monday references, after a separate strong Monday cash session. The strongest counterweight is lower Treasury yields and a softer dollar, which can help ease valuation pressure. The 10-year yield fell 2.4 basis points to 4.894%, and the dollar index lost 0.44%, each versus its own Monday reference. If declines spread beyond chipmakers after the 09:30 ET cash open, the cautious view strengthens. Improving breadth and steady or lower yields would weaken it.
note.zh: 开盘倾向偏谨慎，科技股尤其承压。纳指100期货和标普500期货分别较各自周一参考值下跌2.05%和1.23%，周一现货市场此前收涨。主要缓冲来自美债收益率和美元走低，有助于缓解部分估值压力。10年期美债收益率较周一参考值下降2.4个基点至4.894%，美元指数较自身周一参考值下跌0.44%。若美东时间09:30现货开盘后跌势扩散到芯片股之外，谨慎判断将得到加强；若市场广度改善且收益率持稳或继续回落，谨慎判断将减弱。
